cards.ex: She's always been close-mouthed about her personal life.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z shaxsiy hayoti haqida gapirishdan tiyilgan.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga gap aytmaydigan, sir saqlay oladigan odam haqida.

cards.ex: The company tried to sweep the scandal under the rug.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mojarani yashirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yoki xato e'tibordan chetda qoldirildi, yashirildi.

cards.ex: I heard they were talking about me behind my back.
cards.exUz: Eshitishimcha, ular men haqimda orqamdan gapirishayotgan ekan.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir ruxsatisiz yoki xabarisiz qilingan ish.

cards.ex: He has his eyes and ears everywhere in the organization.
cards.exUz: Uning tashkilotda hamma joyda ko'z va qulog'i bor.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir uchun ma'lumot to'plovchi odamlar.

cards.ex: If you play your cards right, you could get a promotion.
cards.exUz: Agar to'g'ri harakat qilsangiz, lavozimga ko'tarilishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'l tutib, o'zingizga foyda keltirish.

cards.ex: Be careful not to give away any secrets during the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar davomida biron bir sirni oshkor qilmaslikka harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Sirni bilib qolganlarga aytib berish.

cards.ex: The media should respect people's private lives.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari odamlarning shaxsiy hayotini hurmat qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Omma uchun emas, faqat o'zingiz uchun bo'lgan hayot.

cards.ex: She's keeping her plans close to the vest until she's ready to announce them.
cards.exUz: U rejalari haqida e'lon qilishga tayyor bo'lmaguncha sir saqlayapti.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni yoki rejalaringizni yashirish.

cards.ex: They offered him hush money to keep quiet about what he saw.
cards.exUz: Ular unga ko'rgan narsalari haqida jim turishi uchun og'iz yopish puli taklif qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sir saqlash uchun to'lanadigan pul.

cards.ex: As a lawyer, she has access to privileged information.
cards.exUz: Advokat sifatida uning maxsus ma'lumotlarga kirish huquqi bor.
cards.uzDef: Faqat ma'lum bir guruhga tegishli bo'lgan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: We had to sign a confidentiality agreement before starting the project.
cards.exUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin sir saqlash shartnomasini imzolashimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni sir saqlashni talab qiluvchi shartnoma.

cards.ex: I don't want to air our dirty laundry in public.
cards.exUz: Men shaxsiy muammolarimizni omma oldida muhokama qilishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: O'z shaxsiy muammolaringizni omma oldida muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: She received a love letter from a secret admirer.
cards.exUz: U sirli muxlisidan sevgi xatini oldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini yashirgan, kimnidir sevuvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: The details of the new product launch are still under wraps.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulotning ishga tushirilishi tafsilotlari hali ham sir tutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot yashirilgan, omma uchun emas.

cards.ex: It's an open secret that they're planning to merge.
cards.exUz: Ularning birlashishni rejalashtirayotgani oshkora sir.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, lekin rasman tan olinmaydigan sir.

cards.ex: It took him hours to crack the code.
cards.exUz: U kodni yechish uchun soatlab vaqt sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab narsani tushunish yoki muammoni hal qilish.

cards.ex: Make sure to adjust your privacy settings on social media.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda maxfiylik sozlamalarini sozlashni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni kim ko'rishini nazorat qilish uchun sozlamalar.

cards.ex: His sudden wealth was a red flag for the investigators.
cards.exUz: Uning to'satdan boyib ketishi tergovchilar uchun xavf belgisi edi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibor berish kerak bo'lgan ogohlantiruvchi belgi.

cards.ex: Remember, loose lips sink ships, so don't share any sensitive information.
cards.exUz: Unutmang, tilni tiymoq kerak, shuning uchun hech qanday maxfiy ma'lumotni baham ko'rmang.
cards.uzDef: Gapni nazorat qila olmaslik xavfli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He has a squeaky clean reputation.
cards.exUz: Uning toza obro'si bor.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday qonunbuzarlik yoki xato qilmagan.

cards.ex: It's time for them to bury the hatchet and move on.
cards.exUz: Ularning yarashib, oldinga siljish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etgan janjalga chek qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: He seemed nervous, like he had something to hide.
cards.exUz: U hayajonlangan ko'rinardi, go'yo yashiradigan narsasi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Sir saqlashga majbur bo'lgan narsa yoki ma'lumotga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: That room is off-limits to visitors.
cards.exUz: Bu xona mehmonlar uchun taqiqlangan.
cards.uzDef: Kirishga yoki muhokama qilishga ruxsat etilmagan joy yoki mavzu.

cards.ex: They kept me in the dark about their plans.
cards.exUz: Ular meni rejalari haqida be'xabar qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida xabardor bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm going to level with you, I don't think this is a good idea.
cards.exUz: Sizga rostini aytaman, men bu yaxshi fikr deb o'ylamayman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan rost va ochiq gaplashish.

cards.ex: He was standing too close, invading my personal space.
cards.exUz: U juda yaqin turib, mening shaxsiy hududimga tajovuz qildi.
cards.uzDef: Odam o'zini qulay his qilishi uchun atrofidagi masofa.

cards.ex: The company used a marketing campaign as a smokescreen to hide its financial problems.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining moliyaviy muammolarini yashirish uchun marketing kampaniyasidan tuman sifatida foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni yashirish uchun ataylab chalg'ituvchi narsa.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on your progress.
cards.exUz: Menga yutuqlaringiz haqida xabar berib turing.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yangiliklardan xabardor qilib turish.

cards.ex: My computer is my private domain.
cards.exUz: Mening kompyuterim - bu mening xususiy mulkim.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bir kishiga tegishli bo'lgan joy yoki ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The police officer went undercover to investigate the drug ring.
cards.exUz: Politsiyachi giyohvand moddalar savdosini tekshirish uchun yashirincha bordi.
cards.uzDef: O'z shaxsini yashirib, ma'lumot to'plash.
